care_tips: VL Gehun 907 and VL 892 are specially bred by ICAR-VPKAS Almora for rainfed/irrigated Uttarakhand hills.
UP 2628 and HD 2967 give highest yields in Udham Singh Nagar and Haridwar plains.
First irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) 21-25 days after sowing is mandatory for high tillering.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: 50% Nitrogen + Full Phosphorus (DAP) + Full Potash (MOP) at final ploughing.
Top dress: 25% Nitrogen after first irrigation, balance 25% at boot stage.
disease_management: Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust): Spray Propiconazole (Tilt 25 EC) @ 1 ml/L upon first yellow stripe sighting.
Loose Smut / Karnal Bunt: Treat seeds with Carbendazim 50 WP @ 2.5 g/kg seed before sowing.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-VPKAS Almora & GBPUAT Pantnagar certified high-yielding wheat varieties for Uttarakhand.

Paddy / Basmati Rice.suggested_varieties_raw: Pant Dhan 26, VL Dhan 156, VL Dhan 158, Pant Sugandh Dhan 16, Pant Sugandh Dhan 17

agronomy.water_requirement: Standing water 2-5 cm during tillering to panicle initiation
care_tips: Pant Sugandh Dhan 16/17 are premium aromatic Basmati selections from GB Pant University (Pantnagar) ideal for Udham Singh Nagar & Haridwar.
VL Dhan 156 and VL Dhan 158 are cold-tolerant varieties specifically developed for mid-altitude valleys (600-1200m).
Maintain 20x15 cm hill spacing with 2 seedlings per hill.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: Apply 1/3 N + entire P + entire K + 25 kg Zinc Sulphate/ha at puddling.
Top dressing: 1/3 N at active tillering (3 weeks), 1/3 N at panicle emergence.
disease_management: Bacterial Leaf Blight: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L with Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L.
Blast (Pyricularia): Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L water.
Brown Planthopper: Maintain alternate wetting and drying; spray Pymetrozine 50 WG @ 0.6 g/L.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Direct recommendation from Pantnagar Rice Research Station & ICAR-VPKAS Almora.

agronomy.water_requirement: High; regular irrigation every 10-15 days during summer till monsoon sets in
care_tips: Co Pant 94211 & Co Pant 84211 are early maturing, high-sugar varieties developed by GBPUAT Pantnagar with excellent frost tolerance.
Use two-budded setts treated with Carbendazim 0.1% to prevent Red Rot.
Trench planting at 90-120 cm row distance improves sucrose content and makes mechanical earthing-up easier.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: 1/3 N + Full P & K in furrows before sett placement.
Top dress: 1/3 N at 45 days (tillering), remaining 1/3 N at 90 days before monsoon.
disease_management: Red Rot: Strictly use healthy seed canes of resistant varieties Co Pant 94211/84211; soak setts in hot water or Bavistin.
Top Borer / Shoot Borer: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G @ 25 kg/ha in root zone.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Co Pant varieties are the lifeline of sugar mills in US Nagar, Haridwar, and Doiwala Dehradun.

Finger Millet (Mandua).suggested_varieties_raw: VL Mandua 376, VL Mandua 382, VL Mandua 402, VLM 352

agronomy.water_requirement: Low; drought-hardy rainfed crop requiring 350-500 mm rainfall
care_tips: VL Mandua 376, 382, 402 and VLM 352 bred by VPKAS Almora yield 25-30% higher than traditional landraces.
Rich in dietary calcium (344 mg/100g) and iron; high market demand under Uttarakhand Millets Mission.
Direct line sowing or transplanting 20-day seedlings gives 30% higher grain yield than broadcasting.
fertilizer_guide: Apply 5-8 tonnes well-decomposed FYM/compost per hectare.
Chemical basal dose: 20 kg N + 20 kg P2O5 + 20 kg K2O at sowing; top dress 20 kg N after 30 days.
disease_management: Blast (Magnaporthe grisea): Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg or Carbendazim @ 2 g/kg.
Foliar spray of Kitazin 48 EC @ 1 ml/L if neck blast appears at flowering.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-VPKAS Almora spearheads national breeding for finger millet; VLM varieties are national benchmarks.

Barnyard Millet (Jhangora).suggested_varieties_raw: VL Madira 172, VL Madira 207, VL Madira 254

agronomy.water_requirement: Extremely low; highly drought-resilient and flood-resilient
care_tips: VL Madira 172, VL Madira 207 and 254 are benchmark varieties developed by VPKAS Almora for high altitudes (1000-2200m).
Matures in just 85-95 days, providing the earliest food grain buffer in high hill terraced farms.
Can withstand severe water stress and marginal, shallow stony soils.
fertilizer_guide: Add 4-5 tonnes FYM/compost. In fertilized plots apply 20 kg N and 20 kg P2O5 at sowing.
One weeding 25-30 days after emergence.
disease_management: Head smut: Seed treatment with Thiram or Carbendazim @ 2 g/kg seed.
Shoot fly: Sow with the onset of pre-monsoon showers to avoid peak insect activity.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Key hill nutrition crop documented in ICAR Uttarakhand State Summary.

agronomy.water_requirement: Critical at knee-high, tasseling, and silking stages; waterlogging is detrimental
care_tips: Pant Sankar Makka-1, Gaurav and Surya are high-yield cultivars from Pantnagar for Doon Valley, Kalsi, and Nainital foothills.
Provide good drainage in terrace fields as maize roots rot in waterlogged soils.
Earthing up at 30 days prevents lodging during strong mountain wind storms.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: 1/3 N + Full P + Full K at sowing time.
Top dress: 1/3 N at knee-high stage (30-35 DAS), 1/3 N at silking.
disease_management: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda): Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.4 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L in leaf whorls.
Turcicum Leaf Blight: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Pant Sankar Makka-1 developed by GBPUAT Pantnagar.

agronomy.water_requirement: Moderate; frequent light irrigations every 7-10 days
care_tips: Kufri Khyati and Kufri Pushkar are early/medium-maturing, late-blight-tolerant varieties ideal for Nainital (Bhowali), Almora, Dehradun and Barkot.
Use certified seed tubers of 35-45 mm size with 2-3 active sprouts.
Perform ridge earthing up twice: first when plants are 15-20 cm high, second 2 weeks later.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: Apply 20 tonnes FYM/ha + 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O in furrow ridges.
Top dress: Remaining 50% N at first earthing-up (30-35 DAS).
disease_management: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans): Preventive spray with Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L; curative spray with Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate) @ 3 g/L.
Potato Aphids: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-CPRI Kufri & GBPUAT Pantnagar certified potato package.

agronomy.water_requirement: Rainfed in high hills; moisture sensitive at flowering and pod filling
care_tips: Harsil (Uttarkashi) and Munsyari (Pithoragarh) are world-famous GI-candidate terroirs for premium organic Rajma.
Arun, HUR 301, HUR 203 are certified high-protein, bush/semi-trailing cultivars.
Unlike other pulses, Rajma lacks native Rhizobium nodules in plains, but high hill soils have native symbionts; seed inoculation with Rhizobium phaseoli improves yield by 20%.
fertilizer_guide: Incorporate 10 tonnes well-rotted FYM/compost per hectare.
Apply 40 kg N + 60 kg P2O5 + 40 kg K2O basal, and 40 kg N top dressed at 30 days.
disease_management: Anthracnose: Treat seeds with Carbendazim @ 2 g/kg; spray Carbendazim @ 1 g/L if pod lesions appear.
Bean Rust: Spray Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1 ml/L.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Celebrated Uttarakhand hill specialty documented in ICAR & State Agriculture Roadmap.

care_tips: VL Bhat 201 and VL Bhat 202 are released by ICAR-VPKAS Almora with high protein (42%) and antioxidant anthocyanin coat.
Recommended for Almora, Bageshwar, Pithoragarh and Ranikhet terraces.
Inoculate seeds with Bradyrhizobium japonicum culture before sowing.
fertilizer_guide: Basal: 20 kg N + 60 kg P2O5 + 40 kg K2O per hectare.
Apply 20 kg Sulphur per hectare for higher oil and protein content.
disease_management: Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV): Transmitted by whitefly; spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.5 ml/L.
Pod blight / Anthracnose: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/kg.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-National Soybean Research Institute (NSRI) & VPKAS certified varieties.

suggested_varieties: GSC-6 (canola sarson; check local suitability before selection)
Mustard.suggested_varieties_raw: GSC-6 (canola sarson; check local suitability before selection)

agronomy.water_requirement: Low to medium; 2-3 irrigations (rosette stage and siliqua development)
care_tips: GSC-6 (canola sarson) offers premium low-erucic acid oil suitable for Udham Singh Nagar (Sitarganj) and Haridwar.
Ensure proper spacing of 30x10 cm by thinning 15-20 days after germination.
Sulphur application is essential for maximizing oil recovery (>40%).
fertilizer_guide: Basal: 50% N + 100% P + 100% K + 20 kg elemental Sulphur or Gypsum @ 200 kg/ha.
Top dress: 50% N after first irrigation (30-35 DAS).
disease_management: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi): Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.25 g/L.
White Rust (Albugo candida): Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L.

agronomy.sowing_window: October - November (Plains), May - June (Off-season high hills)
agronomy.water_requirement: Sensitive to waterlogging; 2-3 light irrigations at flowering and pod filling
care_tips: Vivek Matar 13 and Vivek Matar 15 bred by ICAR-VPKAS Almora provide early sweet pods with resistance to powdery mildew.
Chakrata (Dehradun), Ramgarh (Nainital) and Tehri produce premium off-season peas that fetch 3x market prices in Delhi-NCR during monsoon.
Treat seeds with Rhizobium leguminosarum culture.
fertilizer_guide: Apply 10-15 tonnes FYM/ha.
Basal chemical dose: Full dose of 30 kg N + 60 kg P2O5 + 40 kg K2O drilled before sowing.
disease_management: Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe pisi): Spray Wettable Sulphur @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1 ml/L.
Pod Borer: Spray Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 3 ml/L or spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-VPKAS Almora developed Vivek Matar series.

care_tips: VL Gahat 8 and VL Gahat 15 are improved selections from ICAR-VPKAS Almora for terraced rainfed hill farming.
Traditional medicinal pulse celebrated for dissolving kidney stones and combating winter mountain chill.
Grown as intercrop with Finger Millet (Mandua) in traditional Baranaja multi-cropping system.
fertilizer_guide: Requires very little synthetic fertilizer; 4-5 tonnes FYM is sufficient.
If soils are depleted, apply 20 kg N and 40 kg P2O5 per ha as basal.
disease_management: Cercospora Leaf Spot: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g/L.
Pod Borer: Spray NSKE 5% or neem seed extract.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: Flagship ICAR Uttarakhand hill crop variety.

suggested_varieties: Golden Delicious (cultivar choice depends on altitude and chill requirement)
Apple.suggested_varieties_raw: Royal Delicious, Red Delicious, Golden Delicious (cultivar choice depends on altitude and chill requirement)

agronomy.water_requirement: Crucial at fruit set, cell expansion (May-June pre-monsoon drought)
care_tips: Royal Delicious, Red Delicious, and Golden Delicious thrive in high-altitude orchards (1800-2600m) in Harsil (Uttarkashi), Mukteshwar (Nainital), and Chamoli.
Ensure 15-20% pollinator cultivars (Golden Delicious / Crab Apple) inter-planted in the orchard.
Regular winter pruning (January) maintains sun exposure and spur vitality.
fertilizer_guide: Apply 40-50 kg FYM per mature tree in December during basin opening.
Apply half N with full P and K in February-March before bud break; remaining half N in May.
disease_management: Apple Scab (Venturia inaequalis): Protective spray of Mancozeb @ 3 g/L at green tip; Difenoconazole @ 0.5 ml/L at pink bud.
San Jose Scale / Mites: Spray Horticultural Mineral Oil (HMO) @ 2% during dormant winter.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: VCSG UUHF Bharsar & ICAR CITH guidelines for Uttarakhand temperate fruit belt.

suggested_varieties: Suruchi (confirm local recommendation and planting-material availability)
Ginger.suggested_varieties_raw: Himagiri, Suprabha, Suruchi (confirm local recommendation and planting-material availability)

agronomy.water_requirement: High; requires mulching with green forest leaves to preserve moisture and suppress weeds
care_tips: Himagiri, Suprabha and Suruchi are certified high-oleoresin, low-fiber varieties suited for Sahaspur (Dehradun) and Narendra Nagar (Tehri).
Plant seed rhizomes (25-30 g) with at least 1-2 good buds at 30x20 cm spacing on raised beds.
Heavy mulching (oak/pine leaves or green twigs) immediately after planting is essential for germination and weed control.
fertilizer_guide: Apply 25-30 tonnes FYM/ha.
Basal: 1/3 N + Full P & K; Top dress 1/3 N at 45 days, 1/3 N at 90 days with earthing-up.
disease_management: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot (Pythium): Dip seed rhizomes in Metalaxyl-Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5 g/L for 30 mins before planting.
Drench nursery beds if yellowing appears in monsoon.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: ICAR-IISR & GBPUAT Pantnagar certified ginger production package.

agronomy.water_requirement: Very critical during fruit development (April-May) to prevent fruit cracking
care_tips: Dehradun, Shahi, and China are world-renowned varieties grown in Doon Valley (Premnagar) and Ramnagar (Nainital).
Spray 1% Potassium Nitrate or 0.4% Borax in April to prevent fruit cracking during hot winds.
Bagging of fruit clusters with non-woven bags protects from fruit borer and bats.
fertilizer_guide: Apply 40 kg FYM per tree in September.
NPK applied in two splits: half in September after monsoon, half in February-March after fruit set.
disease_management: Litchi Mite (Aceria litchii): Prune affected shoots in July; spray Propargite 57 EC @ 2 ml/L.
Fruit Borer: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L 30 days before harvest.
agronomy.icar_gbpuat_note: GBPUAT Pantnagar & Dehradun Valley Horticulture Research Center.
